LAD.label: Left Anterior Descending
LAD.description: Runs down the front interventricular groove toward the apex; supplies the front of the heart.

LCX.label: Left Circumflex
LCX.description: Curls around the left side in the AV groove; supplies the side and back of the heart.

RCA.label: Right Coronary Artery
RCA.description: Runs in the right AV groove, around the right border to the back, then down the back groove (PDA); supplies the right side and bottom.
